paper_title: Dual Modality-Aware Gated Prompt Tuning for Few-Shot Multimodal Sarcasm   Detection
caption: Effect of Prompt Length
model_annotation: The plot titled "Prompt Length vs Accuracy" illustrates the relationship between prompt length and accuracy for two models, labeled "mmsd" and "mmsd2". The x-axis, labeled "Prompt Length", ranges from 2 to 16 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy", ranges from 76 to 81 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 1. The red line with circular markers represents the "mmsd" model, which starts at an accuracy of 81.0 at prompt length 2, drops to 80.2 at prompt length 4, then gradually decreases to approximately 80.1 at prompt length 16. The orange line with circular markers represents the "mmsd2" model, which begins at 77.0 at prompt length 2, decreases to 76.8 at prompt length 4, rises slightly to 77.2 at prompt length 8, and then continues to decline to approximately 76.5 at prompt length 16. Both lines show a general downward trend in accuracy as prompt length increases, with the "mmsd" model consistently outperforming "mmsd2" across all prompt lengths.
